title: The Frozen Mountain
opening: We have to climb the Frozen Mountain. The Frost Queen lives at the top. She will help us, but first we must solve her puzzle.
not_yet: Brrr! Not there. The snow is too deep. Follow the clue!

steps.clue: Start at the Pine Grove. The trees are buried in snow. Wave your wand to shake it off, then climb!
Next, the Warm Springs. Wave your wand and the steam will warm you up. Keep climbing!
The Frost Queen appears! Her riddle: Bridge, then Grove, then Summit. Wave your wand in that order. Bridge first!
You solved it! The Frost Queen waves her staff. Climb to the Frost Throne at the very top and wave your wand!

ending: The Frost Queen smiles. The ice melts and the sun comes out. She says: Go to the Unicorn Forest. It got zapped, and the unicorns need you!
